newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's March tax receipts 9.388 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's March tax receipts 9.388 bln reais.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts in March totalled 9.388 billion reais, Internal Revenue Service Secretary Everardo Maciel said.
Maciel said that in nominal terms the revenue represented an 8.2 percent decline from March 1996's 10.227 billion reais, or a 16.4 percent drop in real terms, adjusted to inflation.
He said the drop was caused by a change in revenue collection procedures. In 1996 taxpayers paid in one lump sum, while this year they are allowed to divide their tax payment into four installments.
The Internal Revenue Service said in a statement that tax revenues amounted to 25.787 billion reais in the first quarter, up from 23.736 billion a year earlier.
